sentences.english: I made a ham sandwich for lunch.
sentences.chinese: 我午饭做了一个火腿三明治。

sentences.english: This sandwich is huge—I don't think I can finish it.
sentences.chinese: 这个三明治太大了，我觉得吃不完。
sentences.scene: 在餐厅面对超大份食物

sentences.english: Whenever I go on a road trip, I pack a couple of sandwiches so we don't have to stop at expensive rest stops.
sentences.chinese: 每次自驾游我都会带几个三明治，这样就不用停在贵的休息站买东西吃了。

sentences.english: I'll have the chicken salad.
sentences.chinese: 我要一份鸡肉沙拉。

sentences.english: This salad is so fresh; the tomatoes taste like they were just picked.
sentences.chinese: 这沙拉好新鲜，番茄尝起来像刚摘的。
sentences.scene: 在朋友家吃晚餐时称赞

sentences.english: I tried to eat a salad for lunch every day this week, but by Friday I was dreaming about pizza.
sentences.chinese: 这周我试着每天午饭都吃沙拉，但到了星期五我做梦都在想披萨。
sentences.scene: 健康饮食计划中的挣扎

sentences.english: I want a hamburger and fries.
sentences.chinese: 我想要一个汉堡和薯条。

sentences.english: Let's fire up the grill and make hamburgers this weekend.
sentences.chinese: 这个周末我们生火烤点汉堡吃吧。

sentences.english: My dad makes the best homemade hamburgers with a secret sauce that he refuses to share the recipe for.
sentences.chinese: 我爸爸做的自制汉堡最好吃了，他有个秘密酱汁配方，死活不肯分享。

sentences.english: I scream for ice cream!
sentences.chinese: 我要吃冰淇淋！
sentences.scene: 孩子们听到冰淇淋车的声音

sentences.english: It's so hot outside; let's walk to the shop and get some ice cream.
sentences.chinese: 外面太热了，我们走去店里买点冰淇淋吧。
sentences.scene: 炎热的下午提议去降温

sentences.english: Every time I visit my grandma, she pulls out a tub of my favorite ice cream from the freezer, even if I just had dinner.
sentences.chinese: 每次去看奶奶，她都会从冰箱里拿出一大桶我最爱的冰淇淋，哪怕我刚吃过晚饭。
sentences.scene: 奶奶总是用冰淇淋宠爱孙辈

sentences.english: I'd like a cup of tea, please.
sentences.chinese: 请给我来杯茶。
sentences.scene: 在咖啡馆或朋友家做客

sentences.english: Would you like some tea? I just made a fresh pot.
sentences.chinese: 你要喝茶吗？我刚泡了一壶新鲜的。

sentences.english: On cold winter nights, I wrap myself in a blanket and sip hot tea while reading a book, and it's the most relaxing thing.
sentences.chinese: 在寒冷的冬夜，我裹着毯子，一边喝着热茶一边看书，那是最放松的事了。

sentences.english: The air smells so fresh after rain.
sentences.chinese: 雨后空气闻起来真清新。
sentences.scene: 雨后深吸一口户外空气

sentences.english: I always buy fresh bread from the bakery on Saturday mornings.
sentences.chinese: 我每周六早上都会从面包店买新鲜面包。

sentences.english: After sitting in the office all day, I needed some fresh air, so I took a long walk along the river.
sentences.chinese: 在办公室坐了一整天后，我需要呼吸点新鲜空气，于是沿着河边走了很久。

sentences.english: An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
sentences.chinese: 一天一苹果，医生远离我。

sentences.english: I'm trying to cook healthier meals for my family this year.
sentences.chinese: 今年我试着给家人做更健康的饭菜。

sentences.english: My doctor told me that as long as I stay active and eat healthy most of the time, I don't have to give up my favorite snacks completely.
sentences.chinese: 医生告诉我，只要我保持运动并且大部分时间吃得健康，就不必完全戒掉我最爱的零食。
sentences.scene: 分享医生给出的平衡建议

sentences.english: Mmm, this soup is delicious!
sentences.chinese: 嗯，这汤太好喝了！
sentences.scene: 品尝第一口汤时不由自主的赞叹

sentences.english: You have to try this cake; it's the most delicious thing I've ever had.
sentences.chinese: 你一定要尝尝这块蛋糕，这是我吃过最好吃的东西。
sentences.scene: 兴奋地向朋友推荐甜品

sentences.english: The little restaurant down the street looks like nothing special, but the food is absolutely delicious and the prices are great.
sentences.chinese: 街角那家小馆子看着不起眼，但食物绝对美味，价格也实惠。
sentences.scene: 发现一家隐藏的美食小店

sentences.english: Careful, the plate is hot!
sentences.chinese: 小心，盘子很烫！
sentences.scene: 服务员上菜时提醒顾客

sentences.english: I love hot wings, but they always make my eyes water.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢吃辣鸡翅，但它们总是辣得我流眼泪。
sentences.scene: 吃辣食物时的又爱又恨

sentences.english: It was so hot at the beach that the sand burned our feet, and we had to run straight into the water.
sentences.chinese: 海滩上热得沙子烫脚，我们只好直接冲进水里。

sentences.english: That was really sweet of you.
sentences.chinese: 你真是太贴心了。
sentences.scene: 对别人善意的举动表示感谢

sentences.english: This lemonade is a little too sweet for me; could you add more water?
sentences.chinese: 这柠檬水对我来说有点太甜了，能再加点水吗？

sentences.english: My little niece drew me a picture and left it on my desk; it was the sweetest surprise after a long day.
sentences.chinese: 我的小侄女画了幅画放在我桌上，那真是漫长一天后最甜蜜的惊喜。

sentences.english: Can I have a cold drink?
sentences.chinese: 我能来杯冷饮吗？

sentences.english: Make sure you drink plenty of water when you're out in the sun.
sentences.chinese: 在太阳底下一定要多喝水。

sentences.english: After the long hike, we sat on the grass and shared a drink while watching the sunset over the valley.
sentences.chinese: 长途徒步后，我们坐在草地上，分享着一瓶饮料，看着夕阳沉入山谷。
sentences.scene: 户外运动后的惬意时刻

sentences.english: I'm so thirsty right now.
sentences.chinese: 我现在好渴。

sentences.english: If you're thirsty, there's cold lemonade in the fridge.
sentences.chinese: 如果你渴了，冰箱里有冰柠檬水。
sentences.scene: 招待朋友时告知饮品位置

sentences.english: The salty popcorn made us really thirsty, so we ended up drinking the whole bottle of soda before the movie even started.
sentences.chinese: 咸爆米花让我们渴得要命，结果电影还没开始，我们就把整瓶汽水喝光了。
sentences.scene: 看电影前的零食导致口渴

sentences.english: Green is my favourite color.
sentences.chinese: 绿色是我最喜欢的颜色。

sentences.english: This song is my absolute favourite right now; I play it on repeat.
sentences.chinese: 这首歌是我目前的最爱，我循环播放。

sentences.english: My grandmother's apple pie is still my favourite dessert, and nothing from any fancy bakery even comes close.
sentences.chinese: 奶奶做的苹果派仍然是我最爱的甜点，任何高级面包房的出品都差远了。

sentences.english: The food at this cafe is great.
sentences.chinese: 这家咖啡店的食物很棒。

sentences.english: I didn't have time to cook, so I just ordered food delivery.
sentences.chinese: 我没时间做饭，就直接点了外卖。

sentences.english: One of the best parts of traveling is trying all the different local food that you can't get back home.
sentences.chinese: 旅行最棒的部分之一，就是品尝各种在家吃不到的当地美食。

sentences.english: Dear Mom, I miss you.
sentences.chinese: 亲爱的妈妈，我想你了。

sentences.english: Oh dear, I think I left my keys inside the car.
sentences.chinese: 哎呀，我好像把钥匙忘车里了。
sentences.scene: 突然发现忘东西时的惊呼

sentences.english: My dear friend sent me the most thoughtful birthday gift, and it made me feel so loved.
sentences.chinese: 我亲爱的朋友送了我一份最贴心的生日礼物，让我感到备受珍爱。
sentences.scene: 收到朋友贴心礼物时的感动

sentences.english: Chop the onion into small pieces.
sentences.chinese: 把洋葱切成小丁。

sentences.english: Every time I cut an onion, my eyes start to burn and water.
sentences.chinese: 每次切洋葱，我的眼睛就开始辣得流泪。

sentences.english: I tried wearing swimming goggles to chop the onion, and my family laughed at me, but hey, it actually worked!
sentences.chinese: 我试着戴着泳镜切洋葱，家人都在笑我，但嘿，这招还真管用！
sentences.scene: 用搞笑方法对抗洋葱辣眼
